status: Design declaration; final source/checkpoint/threshold freeze is a separate artifact
objective: Test whether synthetic-only structural episode training and spatially consistent local matching improve one-reference category localization toward the official image-guided OWL-ViT baseline.

hypernet_constraints.reference_annotation: One existing boxed reference crop; no query ground-truth boxes or masks supplied to inference
hypernet_constraints.synthetic_pretraining: Own procedurally rendered 2D images; report actual consumed episodes and views
hypernet_constraints.development_data: Real labeled DEV images may be used for engineering decisions and scalar threshold calibration; therefore this is not a no-natural-development-data claim

hypothesis: Matched structural hard negatives plus independently varied same-family instances teach useful local relations. Checking the arrangement of local evidence at inference may help beyond a bag-of-parts matcher.
arms: HyperNet v17 local spatial matcher, trained from the shared random initialization
Matched no-geometry control: same data, initialization, train budget and heads, but regional bag-of-parts aggregation replaces spatial alignment
Untrained initialization of the spatial matcher
Raw grayscale normalized cross-correlation with a fixed scale/aspect search
Official google/owlvit-base-patch32 image-guided detector, pinned revision cbc355fb364588351c5d51c7f74465e8e7ec6f72
ablation_scope: The control changes the local aggregation operator as well as removing relative position checks. It is evidence about this implementation, not a pure isolated theorem about geometry.

training_pilot.reason: Measured roughly 0.5 seconds per B16 GPU update. Establish learning and transfer before multiplying data volume.
training_pilot.selection: Use final fixed-budget checkpoints. Any pre-TEST development change must be recorded with failed runs preserved. No checkpoint selection using fresh TEST results.

data.test_selection: Metadata-only selection before fetching pixels; exclude all prior HyperNet COCO source IDs and target-category crowd annotations
data.freshness_limit: Fresh to HyperNet development, not proven unseen by OWL: COCO is among its training datasets
data.independence: Pairs sharing a query photo are correlated; do not call 6912 pairs independent images

primary_endpoint.name: Macro top-one localized recall at IoU >= 0.5
primary_endpoint.calibration: Each method gets one global score threshold fitted to at most 5% of valid negative DEV pairs. Ties are handled conservatively.
primary_endpoint.report_together: Actual fresh TEST false-positive rate, false alarms per 10000 negative pairs, paired photo-cluster confidence intervals, and category counts
primary_endpoint.interpretation: A larger recall at a larger observed false-positive rate is a tradeoff, not an unconditional win.

secondary_endpoints: Localized recall and realized false alarms using a stricter DEV cutoff of 10 false alarms per 10000 negative pairs
Held-out synthetic whole-program and reserved-composition localization; no claim these alone establish natural-image transfer
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap resamples whole query photos, preserving all 12 targets per photo. Reference choices and calibrated thresholds remain fixed; their variability is not included.
novelty: Formula-generated pretraining, episodic matching, local correlations, geometric voting and exemplar-conditioned box regression already exist. This experiment does not by itself establish algorithmic novelty. See novelty_scope.json.
